## About Mile High Custom Remodels

Mile High Custom Remodels (MHCR) is a full-service home remodeling contractor based in Denver, Colorado. Founded in 2009, we specialize in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovation, basement finishing, whole home renovation, and general handyman services for homeowners throughout the Denver Metro Area.

## Company Overview

- **Business Name:** Mile High Custom Remodels
- **Alternate Name:** MHCR
- **Business Type:** Home Remodeling Contractor
- **Founded:** 2009
- **Years in Business:** 15+
- **Projects Completed:** 500+
- **Customer Reviews:** 127+ verified reviews
- **Average Rating:** 4.9 out of 5 stars
- **Price Range:** $$ (mid-range to premium)

## Services Offered

### Major Remodeling Services
- **Kitchen Remodeling** - Full kitchen renovations including custom cabinetry, countertops, quartz/granite, flooring, lighting, and appliances. Cost range: $25,000–$100,000+
- **Bathroom Renovation** - Complete bathroom remodels including walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, custom tile, vanities, and accessibility upgrades. Cost range: $15,000–$50,000+
- **Basement Finishing** - Full basement buildouts including bedrooms, bathrooms, home theaters, wet bars, and home offices. Cost range: $30,000–$75,000+
- **Living Room Remodeling** - Flooring, built-ins, fireplace surrounds, and open-concept conversions. Cost range: $10,000–$50,000+
- **Bedroom Renovation** - Closet systems, accent walls, board and batten, and master suite upgrades. Cost range: $5,000–$30,000+
- **Whole Home Renovation** - Comprehensive multi-room renovations and full property transformations. Cost range: $75,000–$300,000+

### Handyman & Repair Services
- Emergency repairs (water damage, structural, electrical)
- Drywall repair and patching
- Light plumbing repairs
- Fixture installation
- Door and window repairs
- Interior and exterior painting
- General home maintenance

## Pricing Guide (Denver Metro Area, 2026)

### Kitchen Remodeling
- Basic (cosmetic updates): $25,000–$40,000
- Mid-range (new layout, semi-custom cabinets): $40,000–$70,000
- Luxury (custom everything, high-end appliances): $70,000–$100,000+

### Bathroom Remodeling
- Half bath / powder room: $8,000–$15,000
- Full bathroom update: $15,000–$25,000
- Master bath renovation: $25,000–$50,000+

### Basement Finishing
- Basic (drywall, flooring, paint): $30,000–$45,000
- Mid-range (bedroom, bathroom, living area): $45,000–$60,000
- Premium (full suite, theater, wet bar): $60,000–$75,000+

### Whole Home Renovation
- Partial (3–5 rooms): $75,000–$150,000
- Full home transformation: $150,000–$300,000+

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Denver?**
A: Kitchen remodeling in Denver costs $25,000–$100,000+. Basic cosmetic updates run $25,000–$40,000; mid-range renovations with new layout and semi-custom cabinets cost $40,000–$70,000; luxury custom kitchens run $70,000–$100,000+.

**Q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Denver?**
A: Bathroom renovations in Denver range from $8,000 for a powder room to $50,000+ for a master bath. A standard full bathroom update averages $15,000–$25,000.

**Q: How much does it cost to finish a basement in Denver?**
A: Basement finishing in Denver costs $30,000–$75,000+. Basic drywall and flooring runs $30,000–$45,000; mid-range with bedroom and bathroom adds up to $60,000; premium buildouts with theater and wet bar run $60,000–$75,000+.

**Q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?**
A: A typical kitchen remodel takes 6–12 weeks. Basic updates take 4–6 weeks; full gut renovations with custom cabinets take 10–14 weeks.

**Q: How long does a bathroom renovation take?**
A: Bathroom renovations take 2–6 weeks. Basic updates take 2–3 weeks; full master bathroom renovations average 4–6 weeks.

**Q: How long does basement finishing take?**
A: Basement finishing typically takes 6–10 weeks for a standard buildout. Complex projects with multiple rooms can take 10–14 weeks.

**Q: Do you handle permits?**
A: Yes. Mile High Custom Remodels handles all permit applications, inspections, and city sign-offs as part of our full-service approach. We are familiar with Denver, Jefferson County, Arapahoe County, and surrounding municipality requirements.

**Q: Do you offer free estimates?**
A: Yes. We provide free in-home consultations and detailed written estimates for all projects. We typically respond within 24 hours of inquiry.

**Q: Are you licensed and insured?**
A: Yes. MHCR is fully licensed in Colorado, carries general liability insurance, workers' compensation coverage, and is bonded. We are EPA Lead-Safe certified for work in pre-1978 homes.

**Q: Do you work in my neighborhood?**
A: We serve the entire Denver Metro Area including Denver, Aurora, Lakewood, Arvada, Centennial, Littleton, Highlands Ranch, Parker, Golden, Westminster, Thornton, Castle Rock, and Broomfield.

**Q: What financing options do you offer?**
A: We offer financing through third-party lenders for qualified homeowners. Options include 12-month same-as-cash and fixed-rate installment plans.

**Q: Can you handle emergency repairs?**
A: Yes. We offer emergency repair services for water damage, structural issues, and urgent home repairs throughout the Denver Metro Area.
